newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers firm on strong cargo levels.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers firm on strong cargo levels.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Friday were far apart but were quoted firmer by majors on strong cargo prices, causing most buyers to be sidelined, traders said.

Most majors were quoting bunker 180-cst at $126-$127 and 380-cst at $122, about a dollar over Thursday's levels. But a few independents were asking as low as $123 for 180-cst and at $118-$119 for 380-cst.
"Shipowners are not covering their requirement unless they absolutely need to because of the high prices," said a trader.
MDO prices were quoted between $205 and $215 and gas oil steady at $225-$235. --Singapore newsroom (65-870-3082)
